findings.what: stood still, key 1 each 500 ms → At 2:59, Lv 16, 875 kills, health stayed at 36/100 over 20 s of game time

findings.why: A second level costs more than a whole earlier run's gold for a player at this stage; the next purchase is out of reach after a first run
findings.what: (cost curve) → After one level, 힘 cost went 50 → 120 and 생명력 40 → 100 (about 2.4x per level), while the 147 starting gold covered about three first levels

findings.why: the same offer repeats, little variety

findings.why: Buying feels immediate; the pip change is the only sign that something was bought, there was no other visible reaction
